description: Germany only. Get one German employment contract clause (Vertragsbaustein) by key, e.g. B3 (home office), C2 (overtime allowance), D18 (Christmas bonus). Returns when it fits, the inputs with limits and safe defaults, norms, court rulings, mandatory safeguards, what is blocked and the clause text in German with [Name] as placeholder. If required inputs are missing, it lists them instead of returning a text with gaps; call again with angaben.

angaben.description: Inputs of the clause as field and value, e.g. {feld: tage, wert: 2}. Numbers German style (4.500,50), options exactly as listed

eintritt.description: Start of employment, only if the clause needs it (YYYY-MM-DD)

gehalt_monat.description: Gross monthly salary in euro, only if the clause needs it

kennung.description: Key of the clause, e.g. B3

wochenstunden.description: Weekly working hours, only if the clause needs it

name: vertragsbaustein

ergebnis.description: Result of the tool; its fields differ per tool

title: Vertragsbaustein mit Text
